description: Figure 7(b), labeled “Agency A,” is a donut chart illustrating the distribution of task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations for that specific agency. The chart is divided into three colored segments: a large red segment representing “Article generation” at 82.9%, a smaller blue segment for “Article editing” at 14.6%, and a very small yellow segment for “Headline generation” at 2.4%. The chart’s center contains the label “Task Type,” and each segment is clearly labeled with its task category and corresponding percentage. Unlike the other two charts in the figure trio, this one does not have an exploded or offset segment, and all percentage values are displayed directly on the chart. The overall visual emphasizes the overwhelming dominance of article generation as the primary task type for Agency A.
